authoritative_source_rationale: union of the endpoint and sampled deltas; neither source alone is sound, and preferring one lets the other's blind spot become a pass

sampler.blind_spot_note: a process whose entire lifetime is shorter than the polling interval can still be missed; sampling narrows this window, it does not close it

single_phase_note: this is one phase, not an NFR-1 report. Assembling a report from two separately observed phases needs a Measurement that can round-trip through JSON, which harness.py does not provide; build_report takes Measurement objects only. Until that exists, the phases cannot be combined across invocations.
